subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Digital Twins for Planning
description: A quick win: understand Digital Twins for Planning.

hook.text: A digital replica of your supply chain runs what-if simulations in seconds. No real goods are moved.

buildup.text: A digital twin is a virtual model of the physical supply chain that simulates operations in real time.

discovery.text: Planners test changes—new suppliers, route shifts, demand spikes—without risking real operations.

twist.text: A twin is only as good as its data. Inaccurate inputs produce misleading simulations and bad decisions.

climax.text: Unilever uses digital twins to simulate supply chain changes before committing resources.

punchline.text: Simulate first. Decide second. Execute third.

quiz.question: What is a digital twin?
options: A virtual model that simulates the physical supply chain
